method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation register id C2026C00426 (two volumes), retrieved 13 October 2026; no instrument deposited or named by the plan; the small-debt amount (Social Security Act 1991 s 1237AAA), the base interest rate (s 78C) and the FTB dollar amounts (from the Family Assistance Act baseline, rates as printed) are inputs

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 5, 7, 7A, 8, 9, 10, 14A, 15A, 15B, 20, 23, 28, 28AA, 31A(2), 31E, 32A-32D, 32J, 32P, 32AF, 71, 77, 78, 78C, 78D, 93B, 97, 99, 105A, 108(3), 109D, 109E, 111A -- FTB claims (instalment and lump-sum past-period, the early claim day and the claim deadlines), payment by instalment on an income estimate and revised estimates, the FTB reconciliation conditions and the supplements held back until they are met, top-ups and debts on reconciliation, loss of FTB for an unlodged return, the two-nil-years estimate bar, debt due date, interest charge, waiver, and review time limits
